scope: Preliminary estimates and countertestimony; not exhaustive census

findings.claim: Hundreds of thousands of people experienced/reported fragrance
findings.attribution: Capuchin Alberto D’Apolito, quoted by Muse and reproduced Italian testimony
findings.qualification: Broad participant estimate; no itemized written-deposition census recovered

findings.attribution: Official Padre Pio portal, Simona Marmorino2019
findings.qualification: No numerical total or inventory supplied

findings.claim: Did not perceive fragrance in Pio room but did in garden
findings.attribution: Fr Pietro as quoted through Rossi material in Muse

findings.claim: Other people with Fr Lorenzo did not perceive what he perceived
findings.attribution: Rossi investigation passage reproduced by Muse
findings.qualification: Witnesses unnamed in passage; simultaneous non-detection

findings.attribution: Pio confessor Agostino da San Marco in Lamis, diary via Ruffin/Muse
findings.qualification: Later affirmative witness; original diary page still needs retrieval

findings.claim: Aromatic hand odor1920; milder mixed odor room/clothes/gloves1926
findings.attribution: Franciscan physician and psychologist Agostino Gemelli, confidential reports19April1920 and6April1926, published2010
findings.qualification: Not a denial of odor and not a statement of foul body odor. Does question intensity, source localization, supernatural interpretation. Medical-exam history disputed; not adjudicated here.

written_account_total: Not established. Broad participant estimates must not be converted into counts of signed/deposited written accounts.
body_odor_search: No explicit named firsthand foul-body-odor account located in this pass; bounded search finding, not proof none exists.
